analysis_rows.category: API documentation and SDK generation platform
analysis_rows.positioning: Generates API documentation and SDKs from specifications while supporting human-written conceptual guides; handles breaking changes and version management automatically
analysis_rows.key_facts: Reads OpenAPI or Fern Definition files; generates code snippets across nine languages; supports multi-version documentation; integrates with CI/CD via GitHub Actions; uses docs.yml configuration

analysis_rows.symptom: API documentation falls out of sync with actual API behavior
analysis_rows.cause: Manual documentation requires coordination between code changes and documentation updates; teams must maintain separate content not linked to API specification
analysis_rows.evidence: Only 10% of organizations fully document their APIs; manual updates take 4-6 hours per release; developers waste hours troubleshooting phantom issues when docs don't match API behavior
analysis_rows.fix: Use spec-driven approach where API specification is single source of truth; automate documentation regeneration whenever spec changes; integrate into CI/CD pipelines

analysis_rows.symptom: Documentation maintenance creates high operational costs
analysis_rows.cause: Manual documentation requires coordination across engineers and writers; every API change requires updating descriptions, examples, code snippets; separate CMS/wiki requires export and manual publication steps
analysis_rows.evidence: Manual updates take 4-6 hours per release; separate publication workflow delays docs even when API ships on time; developers see mismatch between promise and actual API behavior
analysis_rows.fix: Implement generated documentation from specs with automatic regeneration; integrate docs into same CI/CD pipeline as code; use hybrid approach generating references while manually authoring guides
